canonical_definition: MMMU is a multimodal benchmark designed to evaluate multidisciplinary understanding and reasoning, particularly in college-level or expert-level knowledge-based question-answering tasks. It emphasizes cross-disciplinary problem-solving across diverse domains, often framed as exam-style questions requiring integration of textual and visual information. While some papers describe it as a general multimodal understanding benchmark, others highlight its focus on knowledge-intensive reasoning with relatively low visual dependence compared to other vision-centric tasks.
